- **`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the `SystemContext` view: Patron (person) → Library (software system), with the "Browses the catalogue through [HTTPS]" relationship, drawn in standard C4 colors and left-to-right layout.

One note on how it was produced: I exported the view to PlantUML via the Structurizr tools, but this environment has no internet access (web fetch is denied, DNS is blocked) and no local PlantUML/Java/Graphviz to render it.
